Commentary.Commentary: That is all we have from this game! The action continues on 21st October and we have two more games coming up. Papua New Guinea will take on Bangladesh in the first clash of the day at 2 pm Local (10 am GMT). Later, Oman will face off against Scotland at 6 pm Local (2 pm GMT). Do join us for the same. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Dasun Shanaka, the skipper of Sri Lanka, says that they were concerned after losing early wickets but the partnership between Wanindu Hasaranga and Pathum Nissanka was awesome. Adds that it is a great luxury to have such quality pace bowlers, especially in T20s and he is happy seeing them bowl with such pace. Signs off by saying that they would look to bat well in the next game as the top order is still a concern for them.

Andy Balbirnie, the Irish skipper is down for a chat, he says that Sri Lanka played really well and came back really strongly. Adds that Josh Little was brilliant with the new ball and they were excited when they had Sri Lanka at 8 for 3. Says that the game against Namibia is a knockout game and they are looking forward to it. Hopes that a lot of people will watch that match.

Wanindu Hasaranga, Player of the Match, says when he went out to bat they were 3 down for just 8 runs and he was under pressure. Adds that he wanted to rotate the strike for the first few balls and looked to capitalize after getting a start. Tells that he considers himself a batting all-rounder and he could be seen batting at number 5 quite consistently. In the end, he thanks the Sri Lankan supporters in Sinhalese.

Earlier in the day, after electing to field, Ireland had Sri Lanka on the mat at 8 for 3. They let the advantage slip as some poor bowling and poor decisions saw Sri Lanka get to 171 courtesy of some fine batting from Wanindu Hasaranga and Pathum Nissanka. That proved to be a lot for the Irish as they were bundled out for one more than a ton.

It was the combined effort from the Lankan bowlers. The pacers bowled with fire and got early wickets. The spinners squeezed the runs and were also amongst the wickets. Maheesh Theekshana was the pick of the bowlers with his 3 wickets. Lahiru Kumara and Chamika Karunaratne were very impressive and took 2 each. The rest of the bowlers took 1 each and it was a team performance by them.

A target of 172 was always going to be a tough task and it got even tougher after Ireland lost three wickets in the Powerplay. Andy Balbirnie and Curtis Campher then put up a 50-run stand but it was at a slow pace. The required run rate kept going up and when the time came to accelerate, Campher fell. Once he fell, it was a procession. Just the two batters crossed the 10-run mark and with that scorecard, it is not possible to chase a big total.

Quite a clinical performance from the Lankans and they have confirmed their spot in the Super 12s in emphatic fashion. A win by 70 runs is a big win in T20Is and they have completely dominated the game!

OUT! BOWLED! There it is! Chamika Karunaratne gets the last wicket and Ireland are bundled out for 101! A full toss, around middle and leg. Josh Little moves across to scoop it over short fine leg but he misses it completely and the ball crashes onto his stumps. Sri Lanka WIN THE MATCH BY 70 RUNS!
Another slower ball, outside off. Simi Singh advances down the track and punches it to deep cover for one.
Slower ball, on a length, down leg. Simi Singh misses his flick and the ball clips his pads before going to the keeper on the bounce.
Swing and a miss! Full ball, outside off. Josh Little looks to hoick it over long on but he fails to get any bat on it.
Length ball, around middle and leg. Simi Singh turns it to the leg side for a single. Ireland bring up their 100!
Nearly chopped on! Good-length ball, outside off. Simi Singh looks to slog hard but he gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Length ball, on off. Simi Singh looks to heave it away but it goes off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Full ball, around middle. Josh Little drills it to long on to get off the mark with one.
Josh Little is the last Irish batter.
OUT! BOWLED! You miss, I hit says Dushmantha Chameera! He hurls a full-length ball, around middle. Craig Young looks to heave it away but he misses and the ball crashes onto his stumps.
Change in bowling. Dushmantha Chameera (2-0-14-0) is back on.
Tossed up, around off. Simi Singh hits it back to the bowler.
Floated, around middle. Craig Young drills it to long on for one.
Tossed up, around middle. Craig Young tucks it to mid-wicket.

NOT OUT! Tossed up, outside off. Craig Young looks to sweep but he misses. Kusal Perera behind the stumps whips the bails off. He puts in an appeal and the the decision is sent upstairs. Craig Young has his feet grounded though.
Is that a stumping? There is no bat on that one. Young has his back foot inside the crease.
Nicely tossed up, around off. Craig Young looks to flick it but it goes off the inside edge onto his pads.
Flatter ball, down leg. Simi Singh tucks it to the leg side for a single.
Full toss, outside off. Simi Singh drives it to deep cover for a run.
Leg bye! Length ball, on the pads. Craig Young misses his flick and the ball ricochets off his pads towards square leg. The batters cross for a leg bye!
Who will bat now? Craig Young it is.
Change. Wanindu Hasaranga is back on.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ireland lose their skipper and that should be it for Sri Lanka! Full ball, outside off. Andy Balbirnie looks to carve it through covers but it takes the outer half of the bat and the ball goes straight to Avishka Fernando at backward point. He takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Avishka Fernando b Lahiru Kumara

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, around middle. Simi Singh drills it towards long on to collect a single.
Full ball, outside off. Andy Balbirnie reaches out and digs it out towards third man for one.

OUT! RUN OUT! A direct hit and Mark Adair is gone! Full ball, on off. He hits it to mid off and sets off for a run. Dushmantha Chameera runs in and fires a direct hit at the bowler's end. The TV umpire is called in and one replay shows that Adair is well short. Simi Singh walks out to bat.
Is that a run out? It is a direct hit and Mark Adair is the man in question. He is well short of the crease.
Dot to finish the spell! Full ball, just outside off. Andy Balbirnie gets no bat on it. Maheesh Theekshana ends with figures of 4-0-17-3!
Loopy ball, on off. Adair comes down the track and hits it to long on for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Hit to deep cover for one.
Just a single as this is played to long on.
Mark Adair is the new man in.

OUT! STUMPED! Brilliant work by Kusal Perera behind the stumps! Tossed up, on off. Rock goes for the sweep but misses. Kusal Perera whips the bails off and goes up in an appeal. The TV umpire is called in. It looks like the bails were taken off when Rock had his back leg just outside the crease. The TV umpire takes a few more looks at it and then gives Rock his marching orders.
Commentary.Howout: st Kusal Perera b Maheesh Theekshana

Commentary.Commentary: A stumping decision has been sent upstairs as Kusal Perera looks confident behind the sticks.
Flatter ball, outside off. Rock misses the cut shot.
Full ball, on the pads. Rock flicks it past square leg for one.
Neil Rock walks out now.

OUT! TAKEN! A tiny feather on it and Tector walks back! A short ball, down the leg side. Tector looks to pull but gets a tiny feather on it. Kusal Perera takes it with ease behind the stumps and Lahiru Kumara gets his first.
Commentary.Howout: c Kusal Perera b Lahiru Kumara

Commentary.Commentary: A perfect yorker, on off. Tector hits it back to the bowler. Another dot and the pressure is building up for Ireland.
Full ball, on leg. Flicked past mid-wicket for a couple.
Short ball, on leg. Tector miscues the pull. The ball goes to mid-wicket. Tector looks for one but is sent back.
Length ball, on off. Tector drives it hard back to the bowler. Kumara gets his hands to it and stops it.
Lahiru Kumara (2-0-16-0) is back on.
Flatter ball, on off. Tector works it to mid-wicket for one.
Harry Tector is the new man in. 87 needed in 43 balls now.
OUT! BOWLED! The struggle of Curtis Campher ends! He did not get going today! Tossed up, on middle. Curtis Campher goes for the sweep but misses. The ball clips the pads and goes onto hit the stumps.
Shorter and on the pads. Pulled to deep square leg for one.
Loopy ball, way outside off. Curtis Campher slices it over covers for one.
Tossed up, on off. Hit inside out to deep point for one.
Darted on the pads. Curtis Campher gets hit on the pads while looking to sweep. The ball goes to short fine leg for one.
Maheesh Theekshana comes back into the attack.
Short ball, on off. Andy Balbirnie backs away way too much and then reaches out for it. He plays it to long off for a couple.
FOUR! A much-needed boundary for the Irish! Full ball, outside off. Andy Balbirnie shuffles across and sweeps it past short fine leg for a boundary.
Full ball, on off. Heaved to deep mid-wicket for one.
Length ball, way outside off. Curtis Campher looks to reverse sweep but misses. Wide called.
Just a single as Andy Balbirnie slices this full ball to deep cover.
Full ball, on off. Pushed to cover.
Slower ball, on a length, outside off. Curtis Campher hits it to deep cover for one.
Chamika Karunaratne (2-0-16-1) is back on.
Tossed up, on off. Hit back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, on off. Andy Balbirnie drives it to the right of sweeper cover. The fielder runs across and dives to stop it. Two taken.
Shorter ball, on off. Hit to cover for a quick single.
Tossed up, on off. Curtis Campher sweeps it to fine leg for a couple.
A googly, on off. Andy Balbirnie hits it past the diving cover fielder for one.
Flatter ball, on off. Punched back to the bowler.

Drinks break! Sri Lanka are well and truly top in this game at the moment and Ireland need their skipper, Andy Balbirnie to bat as long as possible and take his side close to the target. They do have wickets in hand but they certainly need to up the ante as the required rate is creeping up. Wanindu Hasaranga comes back to bowl.
A high full toss, on leg. Andy Balbirnie hits it to long on for one.
On a length, outside off. Curtis Campher hits it past cover for one.
A full one, on off. Pushed past covers for one.

FIVE RUNS! Free runs for Ireland! A yorker, on off. Curtis Campher digs it out to mid-wicket and takes off for a run. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Two men backing up cannot stop the ball and it runs to the fence.
Play and a miss! Length ball, outside off. Curtis Campher is beaten while looking to drive it.
On a length, around off. Andy Balbirnie pushes it past point for one.
Lahiru Kumara comes back to bowl. 7 runs came off his first over!
On middle, defended.
A single now as Andy eases it through covers.
Shortish again and on off, Andy pushes it to covers.
Two more! On middle, this is worked wide of long on for two.
Plays the sweep, not right off the middle, it goes off the glove towards fine leg for one.
On middle, Campher pushes it back to the bowler.
A single to end as this short one is hit through square leg.
Shorter and slower outside off, Campher tries to cut but misses.
Shorter again, this is pulled, flat towards deep square leg for one.
SIX! Smashed! That was right off the middle. Brilliant shot! Shorter and on middle, Andy Balbirnie hangs back and hammers the pull, well over the mid-wicket fence. 50 up.
On off, this is pushed to mid off.
That is a beauty! A yorker on the pads, Curtis looks to jam it out but misses. It hits the pad and goes on the leg side. A leg bye. Going down leg.
Chamika Karunaratne (1-0-8-1) is back on.
Another dot to end! On middle, Andy flicks it to mid-wicket.
On off, this is eased down to long off for one.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.

PUT DOWN! Another life for Andy Balbirnie! He tries to play the reverse sweep but fails to ride on top of the bounce. It goes off the splice, the point fielder dives forward, gets two hands to it but spills it.
On middle, defended.
Almost another one! On off, the googly, Andy looks to push it through covers but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Another short one, Campher looks to pull again but misses. End of the first 6, Ireland are 41 for 3.
BEATEN FOR PACE! Short again and outside off, Campher looks to pull but misses.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Welcome boundary! Fuller and on off, this is hit down the ground, past mid off for a boundary by Curtis Campher. Second in three balls.
Outside off, Curtis slashes but misses.
FOUR! That races away! Length and on off, Curtis Campher uses the pace of the bowler and guides it past the slip fielder and down to the third man fence.
On middle, defended.
Flatter ball, around off. Curtis Campher eases it to long off and takes a run. Just 2 runs and a wicket off the over!
Just a tad short, outside off. Curtis Campher cuts it to cover.
Tossed up, outside off. Curtis Campher drives it back to the bowler.
Flatter ball, around middle. Curtis Campher looks to cut but it goes off the inner half of the bat.
Curtis Campher walks out to bat.

OUT! BOWLED! Wanindu Hasaranga strikes in his first over and Ireland are in a spot of bother now! He hurls a googly, around off, turning in sharply. Gareth Delany stays back to cut but he is cramped for room and misses. The ball crashes onto his middle stump.
Tossed up, on middle. Andy Balbirnie tucks it to the leg side for a run.
Wanindu Hasaranga comes to bowl.
A yorker now on middle, Balbirnie jams it out to mid on.

A decision has been sent upstairs to check whether Chamika Karunaratne has taken the catch cleanly. The soft signal is NOT OUT as the on-field umpire feels Karunaratne's feet touched the ropes while taking the catch.

SIX! He stepped on the ropes while taking the catch! That is yet another sharp bumper, Balbirnie is beaten for pace as he tries to pull. It goes off the top edge towards fine leg. The fielder takes it but he is not sure whether he has stepped on the ropes or not. It is taken upstairs and replays show that his foot touches the ropes while taking the catch.
Good length and on off, defended.

FOUR BYES! Big, big swing again! Shorter and outside off, this one jags back in again. Cuts Andy Balbirnie into half as it goes past the inside edge. Keeps swinging away as it beats the batter. Perera dives to his left but has no chance.
On off, Andy guides it to point.
That swung a long way! It lands outside off and jags back in. Andy looks to drive but is beaten on the inside edge.
Lahiru Kumara comes into the attack.
Shorter and outside off, this is cut through point for two.
Flatter and on middle, defended again.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Gareth Delany walks out to bat.

OUT! Straight to the man! Stirling does not last for long despite being given a life. He looks to play the sweep again, this time shuffles across, this is bowled full and on middle, he tries to help it past short fine leg but finds the fielder there. Ireland are in huge trouble now. Lahiru Kumara takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Lahiru Kumara b Maheesh Theekshana

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Stirling will continue to attack! He brings the sweep out. It is angled into his pads and hence, an easy shot. It goes over square leg for a boundary.
On middle, this is worked to square leg.
Maheesh Theekshana comes to bowl.
FOUR! Fortunate again! Another really sharp bumper, Balbirnie plays a duck-pull. He first tries to duck but then looks to pull, it goes off the top edge and down to the fine leg fence.
That was quick! Short and on middle, Andy moves out of the way.
Fortunate run! On off, Stirling swings, it goes off the inside edge past the off pole and down to the fine leg fielder for one.
On middle, this is nudged on the leg side for one.
On middle, solidly kept out.
That is a beauty! Length and it lands outside off and hags back in. Andy looks to drive but it cuts him into half and goes over middle pole.

OUT! TAKEN THIS TIME! Maheesh Theekshana does not make a mistake! He never looked comfortable under it but hung on. Short and on middle, extra bounce. Kevin O'Brien looks to pull but gets a top edge. It goes towards short fine leg where the fielder settles under it and takes it. An early wicket for Lanka, just what they wanted.
Commentary.Howout: c Maheesh Theekshana b Chamika Karunaratne

Commentary.Commentary: Andy Balbirnie is the new man in. Also, Dushmantha Chameera to bowl from the other end.
WIDE! The keeper did really well! Down the leg side, left alone. The keeper dives to his left, gets a hand to it. Saves a boundary for his side.

PUT DOWN! That could prove very costly! This is short and on middle, Stirling looks to pull, one hand comes off the handle. It goes towards deep mid-wicket. Bhanuka Rajapaksa runs to his left and looks to take it with the slide but fails to do so. Can Stirling make them pay?
Stirling gives the charge, this is on a length and around off, it is pushed to covers.
Follows the boundary with a single as he works it through square leg.
FOUR! Cracked away! Shorter and outside off, a gift for Kevin O'Brien. He cuts it through point for a boundary. Good start for Kevin O'Brien.
Ireland and Stirling are underway! Length and on middle, this is worked to mid on for one.
